description: A system with injective successor omitting zero and full subset induction has a unique bijection from the natural numbers preserving zero and successor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.NaturalNumbersAsSets.peano_system_unique.{v} (C : Type v) (c : C) (g : C → C)
  (hg : Function.Injective g) (hc : ∀ (x : C), g x ≠ c)
  (hInd : ∀ (A : Set C), c ∈ A → (∀ x ∈ A, g x ∈ A) → A = Set.univ) :
  ∃! f, Function.Bijective f ∧ f 0 = c ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), f (n + 1) = g (f n)
